geometry.units: CSS pixels; x,y,width,height independently derived from fixed source
geometry.derivation: 1920 x=1920-439-313,y=1080-43-184; 1280 source rem dimensions scale2/3 while viewport height stays900

field_mapping.ASL_source_altitude: existing readTelemetry.altitude from altitude_m; absolute height only; vertical datum unavailable and no sea-level conversion
field_mapping.ALT_source_height: existing readTelemetry.relativeHeight from height_m; independent of absolute height
field_mapping.heading_source_course: existing readTelemetry.heading from heading_deg/yaw_deg; signed value retained

boundaries: Strict platform snapshot has no speed/gimbal/obstacle fields; absent values remain unavailable. The UI Record type does not widen the backend schema.
Unknown heading or camera pitch draws no current-value pointer. Missing height is never derived from the other height.
No obstacle regions, levels or safety conclusion are drawn.
Geometry is source-derived and checked on the real product Vue/Chrome page, not full original runtime pixel equality.
adaptations: Existing execution mode, snapshot status and explicit vertical-datum note remain visible in the telemetry header.

Existing signed snapshot heading is drawn and displayed directly: raw-45deg remains-45.0deg, not the old trail store normalized315deg. No source continuous-course history or second state model is introduced.

Local instrument projection accepts heading[-360,360] and camera pitch[-180,180]. Unknown, non-numeric or out-of-axis angles remain unavailable with no pointer;999deg is not normalized into a plausible value. Valid camera pitch uses the source percentage formula without rewriting the reading.
Unavailable SPD/VS text uses14px source-scaled type instead of the20px numeric type so the explicit unknown label fits inside the fixed frame.

When a valid camera pitch reaches the upper20percent or lower20percent of the axis, the corresponding fixed endpoint text is hidden to avoid overlap with the current-value text. The axis extent, measured value and pointer position are unchanged; missing values still show both endpoint labels and no pointer.
Existing session, confirmation, map and media lifecycle are reused; no new API, telemetry schema, dependency or business controller is added.
